title: CalCare Tool Repair & Calibration Plan Certificate and Results Service Standards
content:
The CalCare Tool Repair & Calibration Plan fixes, tier by tier, what the calibration certificate reports, whether an out-of-tolerance instrument is adjusted, how quickly an out-of-tolerance as-found result is notified, the window for free recalibration after a Corbett calibration error, the certificate reissue fee and the multi-point surcharge.

## Standards by tier

| Tier | As-found readings reported with the certificate | Adjustment back into tolerance included | Out-of-tolerance notice (business days) | Free recalibration window after a Corbett calibration error (days) | Certificate reissue fee (USD) | Multi-point surcharge (percent of the calibration price) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| CalCare Pay-Per-Service | no | yes | 2 | 30 | 15.00 | 25 |
| CalCare Basic Plan | yes | yes | 2 | 30 | 15.00 | 25 |
| CalCare Standard Plan | yes | yes | 1 | 60 | 10.00 | 20 |
| CalCare Accredited Plan | yes | yes | 1 | 60 | 10.00 | 20 |
| CalCare Onsite Plan | yes | yes | 1 | 90 | 0.00 | 15 |
| CalCare Enterprise Plan | yes | yes | 1 | 90 | 0.00 | 10 |

## What each standard means

- **As-found readings**: whether as-found readings are reported with the certificate.
- **Adjustment**: whether adjusting an out-of-tolerance instrument back into tolerance is included in the calibration.
- **Out-of-tolerance notice**: business days within which the customer is notified of an out-of-tolerance as-found result.
- **Free recalibration window**: days after calibration within which an instrument found out of tolerance because of a Corbett calibration error is recalibrated free.
- **Certificate reissue fee**: fee to reissue a certificate with corrected customer data, USD.
- **Multi-point surcharge**: surcharge, percent of the calibration price, for calibration at more test points than the standard procedure.

## Points read from the table

- CalCare Pay-Per-Service is the only tier whose certificate does not report as-found readings; the other five tiers report them.
- Adjustment of an out-of-tolerance instrument back into tolerance is included on all six tiers.
- An out-of-tolerance as-found result is notified within 2 business days on CalCare Pay-Per-Service and CalCare Basic Plan, and within 1 business day on the four higher tiers.
- A certificate reissue with corrected customer data costs 15.00 on the first two tiers, 10.00 on CalCare Standard Plan and CalCare Accredited Plan, and 0.00 on CalCare Onsite Plan and CalCare Enterprise Plan.
- The free recalibration window is 30 days on the first two tiers, 60 days on CalCare Standard Plan and CalCare Accredited Plan, and 90 days on CalCare Onsite Plan and CalCare Enterprise Plan.
